test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the Indian Constitution, every Panchayat, unless sooner dissolved under any law for the time being in force, shall continue for _________ years from the date appointed for its first meeting and no longer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **According to article 243E, every Panchayat, unless sooner dissolved under any law for the time being in force, shall continue for five years from the date appointed for its first meeting and no longer.**
 
• An election to constitute a Panchayat shall be completed
